    Legend:

    • #: Row number within the table.
    • Model: Model family or model type.
    • Fold: Temporal fold used for validation or backtesting.
    • Run: Source run tag.
    • Label: Human-readable row label.
    • Orig PnL (Ret%): Original backtest net PnL with return percentage.
    • New PnL (Ret%): Rerun backtest net PnL with return percentage.
    • Δ PnL: Change in net PnL between compared rows.
    • Orig Total Fric: Original backtest estimated total friction cost.
    • New Total Fric: Rerun backtest estimated total friction cost.
    • Δ Total Fric: Change in estimated total friction.
    • Orig Total Gross PnL: Original backtest gross PnL proxy before friction.
    • New Total Gross PnL: Rerun backtest gross PnL proxy before friction.
    • Δ Total Gross PnL: Change in gross PnL proxy.
    • Orig Net/trade: Original backtest net PnL divided by trade count.
    • New Net/trade: Rerun backtest net PnL divided by trade count.
    • Orig Gross/trade: Original gross PnL proxy divided by original trade count.
    • New Gross/trade: Rerun gross PnL proxy divided by rerun trade count.
    • Orig Positive Edge Retention%: Original share of gross positive edge retained after friction.
    • New Positive Edge Retention%: Rerun share of gross positive edge retained after friction.
    • Orig Benchmark RC (Ret%): Original risk-constrained benchmark PnL and return.
    • New Benchmark RC (Ret%): Rerun risk-constrained benchmark PnL and return.
    • Orig α (RC): Original risk-constrained alpha versus benchmark.
    • New α (RC): Rerun risk-constrained alpha versus benchmark.
    • Δ α (RC): Change in risk-constrained alpha.
    • Orig Benchmark (Ret%): Original unconstrained buy-and-hold benchmark PnL and return for the execution range.
    • New Benchmark (Ret%): Rerun unconstrained buy-and-hold benchmark PnL and return for the execution range.
    • Orig α (adj): Original legacy friction-adjusted alpha: gross PnL return minus the unconstrained buy-and-hold benchmark return.
    • New α (adj): Rerun legacy friction-adjusted alpha: gross PnL return minus the unconstrained buy-and-hold benchmark return.
    • Orig Trades (Entry%): Original executed trade count with original Stage3 entry-signal rate.
    • New Trades (Entry%): Rerun executed trade count with rerun Stage3 entry-signal rate.
    • Δ Trades: Change in trade count.
    • Orig Win%: Original winning-trade percentage.
    • New Win%: Rerun winning-trade percentage.
    • Orig Sharpe: Original backtest Sharpe ratio.
    • New Sharpe: Rerun backtest Sharpe ratio.
    • TrialID (Opt#): Trial ID with Optuna trial number when available.
    • BktID: Backtest session ID.
